facts.fact: The Direction Generale des Impots' June 2025 user guide presents the eTax Guinee portal of tax teleprocedures, where enrolled taxpayers declare their taxes online (teledeclarer), opened in September 2020 to large-enterprise taxpayers and from January 2021 to medium enterprises.
The Direction Generale des Impots' June 2025 user guide says taxpayers enrolled on the eTax Guinee portal pay taxes online (telepayer), the tax administration aiming to ease payment procedures.

systems.platform: eTax-SAFIG2 (new version deployed from 2024, also to decentralised services)
systems.tiers: large enterprises from September 2020, medium enterprises from January 2021

claims.gtmi-c17934bbf4: fact: the guide itself states eTax Guinée in use for online declaration and payment; no 1990 start is stated
